page.overview:
Who is Brognal Bullsmiter?

Brognal Bullsmiter was a legendary Ogre Pit Fighter, that dwelled in Tilea during first years of the Era of Enlightenment.

In the great city of Remas, the brilliant Leonardo da Miragliano directs a reconstruction of the Grand Coliseum. Leonardo builds dozens of innovative devices into the massive structure inspired by conversations with the legendary Ogre himself.
